text: List and account settings use buttons, not clickable text (both clients); the local area reorders like any account

Also (maintainer): the Server admin page's actions — reset password, delete user, refresh — become buttons on both clients (ui/admin/AdminScreen.kt; web AdminPage.tsx). Delete keeps the danger colour; reset and refresh the normal one.

Broadened by the maintainer: 'really any clickable link'. Part 1 applies app-wide on both clients: every text-styled action (Android TextButton outside a dialog; web btn-icon or anchor-styled text used as an action, including mode toggles like 'New here? Register' and the invite 'Ignore') becomes a button. Only a dialog's confirm/dismiss stay text buttons; only real hyperlinks in prose (About) stay links.

Also (maintainer): on the overview, the 'Invitations' (and 'Ignored') section heading is right-aligned, so it is told apart from the left-aligned account headings, and gets the same slim vertical spacing as the account heading (T-307 items 1+2: 12dp above, nothing below, one text line). Android only (the web has no account headings).

All parts on main (HEAD 3579de3a) as three cherry-picked commits, full gate green (app debug 772, web 598). Buttons app-wide on both clients with a shared AppButtons.kt (danger colours, compact padding); kept as text: dialog confirm/dismiss, the password show/hide toggle, real icon buttons, the menu entries and the one prose hyperlink. Local area reorders by sortOrder everywhere; Invitations/Ignored headings end-aligned and slim.
